# Pre-refactor field-save fixture

`cedar_grove_v1.dat.gz` is a gzip-compressed, checksummed v1 field slot generated
by the unmodified game at commit `4ff75db`, before introducing FieldLayout.
It contains only synthetic test work and an isolated test attempt, not player data.

The original layout signature is
`4b93508a852f996a404526525630f7fcb6b2271cd10d8adedd4c9f2364fd70b5`.
Original totals: grass 61,444; dirt/moisture 12,618; chalk 808; mound 18.
Recorded work: 284 cut cells, 84 prepared cells, 256 wet cells, 13 chalk sections,
one accepted mound impact, plus an off-guide chalk stroke. It is an active
training attempt with 123.4 seconds elapsed.

The immutable `resources/layouts/cedar_grove_v1_masks.res` stores validity arrays
captured from that same unmodified build, compressed as a native Godot Resource.
The migration uses those original arrays to reject work outside the v1 masks.
The resource test decompresses the original slot to an isolated `user://` path,
loads it through FieldSave, and checks preservation and v2 round-tripping.
Do not regenerate these fixtures from the refactored implementation.

## HUD text reference

`hud_text_before.json` records 24 tool/proximity states on keyboard and controller (48 pairs of exact mode/prompt strings), captured from the original `game.gd` text logic before Task 5. `hud_cases.gd` reproduces those states. Keep these expected strings independent of the extracted helper; changing them requires an explicit UI wording change. The numeric job indices in the JSON are frozen serialized values 0–4.

## Pre-v4 career migration fixtures

`career_v1.dat`, `career_v2.dat`, `career_v3.dat` and `career_legacy_expected.json` were generated by the unmodified pre-v4 career implementation at `8563cc1` (Task 6), before the v4 code was introduced. They contain synthetic work only. V1 records two full shifts and tool purchases; v2/v3 exercise six home dates and legal investment, with v3 additionally recording service rewards. The v3 route follows the ideal six-date polish purchase choices. The JSON records exact wallet, earnings, rank, bests, club state, schedule and ownership output before migration. Do not regenerate these fixtures from v4. The existing compressed v1 field fixture is unchanged.
